name: a11y-audit
description: WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility scanner (Playwright + axe-core) that generates HTML/PDF client reports

scripts.demo: node scan.mjs ./demo-site/before/index.html --out reports/demo-before --client "Nordic Brew (demo) — before" --manual ./demo-site/before/manual-findings.json && node scan.mjs ./demo-site/after/index.html --out reports/demo-after --client "Nordic Brew (demo) — after"
